title: AntigravityHookPayloadSchema
description: Authoritative contract schema for Antigravity lifecycle hook payloads, documenting official core runtime fields and multi-agent identity extensions.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the current conversation or subagent thread.

transcriptPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the conversation transcript log file (transcript.jsonl).

artifactDirectoryPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the conversation artifact storage directory.

modelName.description: Identifier of the language model backing this agent run.

stepIdx.description: Zero-indexed step counter in the current conversation trajectory.

executionNum.description: Invocation sequence number within the current step.

event.description: The lifecycle hook event triggering this dispatch.

name.description: Name of the tool requested (e.g. run_command, write_to_file, invoke_subagent).

args.description: Dictionary of arguments passed to the tool.

result.description: Tool execution result payload passed during PostToolUse hook events.

agentName.description: Canonical identity name of the agent executing the tool or turn (e.g. 'academic-orchestrator', 'statistics-agent', 'default').

agentRole.description: Descriptive role of the executing agent.

track.description: Execution track: 1 (Built-In Main Developer Agent) or 2 (Academic Multi-Agent System).

isSubagent.description: True if executing within a child subagent thread invoked via invoke_subagent.

subagent.description: Alternative boolean flag indicating subagent execution.

parentConversationId.description: Conversation ID of the parent orchestrator when executing in a subagent thread.

parentConversationIds.description: Chain of ancestor conversation IDs in nested delegations.

subagentDepth.description: Nesting depth of subagent invocation (0 = root agent).

depth.description: Alternative integer indicating delegation nesting depth.

custom_instructions.description: System or prompt instructions supplied to the agent.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the lifecycle payload.
